reason: The pilot is clearly set up so it costs me little, but with 1,350 members and a course that runs as a business, I'm not handing tee times and invoicing to two founders whose only reference club hasn't gone live yet. I'll watch Zwolle first.
objection: Most of our members are over 60, and even with clinics and a printed guide I'm the one who gets the phone calls when they can't log in with an e-mail code or a booking goes wrong. Behind the contract it's still two people, and escrow and an IT partner don't help me on a Saturday morning with a full tee sheet.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing Zwolle live for a full season with its real numbers, and talking to its manager about how many older members actually book through the app and how many extra calls the desk got.
